dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is there anything of note nearby?

dialogues.speaker: Remande
dialogues.text: Not that I remember... Certainly not anything worth taking pictures of.

dialogues.speaker: Remande
dialogues.text: Once we're done preparing the film, we can continue taking boat-tos!

dialogues.speaker: Remande
dialogues.text: Boat-tos! Photos of boats. Boats, photos — by which I mean pictures of the aquabuses.

dialogues.speaker: Remande
dialogues.text: I absolutely adore the aquabus network — really, I'd take a picture of every last detail if I could.

dialogues.speaker: Remande
dialogues.text: My dream is to someday recreate a scale clockwork model of an aquabus without needing to refer to the real object, or even pictures of it.

dialogues.speaker: Remande
dialogues.text: At this moment, I've reached the phase where I'm taking photos daily, and familiarizing myself with them. Wish me well, friend!

dialogues.speaker: Remande
dialogues.text: See you — be sure to take a trip onboard yourself!

dialogues.speaker: Remande
dialogues.text: Of course it does! If you are interested as well, you are welcome to join us aquabus enthusiasts.

dialogues.speaker: Remande
dialogues.text: However, I have a few reminders for newcomers.

dialogues.speaker: Remande
dialogues.text: While admiring the aquabuses, do not behave in any way that might interfere with the normal functioning of aquabus facilities or disturb the tour guides on the aquabuses.
